security.migration_complete.en: Upgrade validated; no pairing is needed. The source backup is security-v3.db.backup. Direct rollback is safe only before v4 accepts new operations: stop the daemon, move security-v4.db and its -wal/-shm files aside, then run the old version. Otherwise follow the development guide to check operations and let their authorizations expire first.
security.migration_complete.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_complete.zh-CN: 升级完成并校验通过，无需重新配对。原库备份为 security-v3.db.backup。仅在 v4 尚未接受新操作时可直接回退：先停止 daemon，移走 security-v4.db 及其 -wal/-shm 文件，再运行旧版。已有 v4 操作时请先按开发说明核对并等待授权期限结束。

security.migration_dry_run.en: Dry run validated; the source is unchanged. Pairing identity, security chain, keys and lease will be preserved; session and account files stay unchanged.
security.migration_dry_run.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_dry_run.zh-CN: 演练验证通过，原库未修改。配对身份、安全链、密钥和租约将原样保留，会话与账户文件不变。

security.migration_failed.en: Upgrade did not complete; the source was not replaced. Check that --home is an existing state directory with daemon.lock, the daemon is stopped, target and backup are absent, disk is writable, the source is valid generation 3, the clock is correct, old deadlines have passed and existing time floors are not far ahead. Publication failure removes files created by this attempt where possible; if cleanup also fails, keep the daemon stopped and resolve leftover files before retrying.
security.migration_failed.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_failed.zh-CN: 升级未完成，原库未替换。请确认 --home 是已有状态目录且有 daemon.lock、daemon 已停止、目标和备份尚不存在、磁盘可写、原库为第 3 代且完整、电脑时间正确、旧请求期限已过且旧水位没有明显领先当前时钟。发布失败会尝试清理本次创建的文件；清理也失败时需停机处理残留文件后重试。

security.migration_old_results.en: Generation 3 acceptance records are not migrated. Old ID queries return unknown and are never reexecuted; check the session before deciding on a new operation. Check the computer clock first; migration preserves old request deadlines and existing time floors without adding the migration time as a new floor.
security.migration_old_results.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_old_results.zh-CN: 第 3 代接受记录不会迁移。旧 ID 的结果查询将返回未知，绝不重新执行；请核对会话后再决定新操作。请先校准电脑时间；迁移保留旧请求期限和已有时间水位，不把迁移时刻写成新水位。

security.migration_usage.en: Usage: go run ./scripts/migrate-security-v4 --home DIR [--dry-run] [--locale zh-CN|en]. DIR must be an existing state directory with security-v3.db and daemon.lock. Check the computer clock, stop the daemon and check old operations first.
security.migration_usage.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_usage.zh-CN: 用法：go run ./scripts/migrate-security-v4 --home DIR [--dry-run] [--locale zh-CN|en]。DIR 必须是已有状态目录（含 security-v3.db 和 daemon.lock）；先校准电脑时间、停止 daemon 并核对旧操作。

security.request_identity_conflict.en: The request ID was reused with a different payload; the original result is unchanged.
security.request_identity_conflict.notes: 电脑端已认证的请求身份冲突；不泄露原载荷或结果。
security.request_identity_conflict.zh-CN: 同一请求 ID 对应不同载荷；原操作结果未改变。

security.result_body_unavailable.en: The operation is settled, but its result body is unavailable.
security.result_body_unavailable.notes: 电脑端精简终局存在但未能保留正文；第 6 步 wire 接入前不作为客户端业务正文。
security.result_body_unavailable.zh-CN: 操作已定案，但结果正文无法恢复。

security.storage_v4_required.en: Local security storage needs generation 4. Stop the daemon and run scripts/migrate-security-v4; pairing is preserved. Old request results cannot be recovered; check pending operations first.
security.storage_v4_required.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.storage_v4_required.zh-CN: 本机安全库需要升级到第 4 代。请先停止 daemon，运行 scripts/migrate-security-v4；无需重新配对。旧请求结果无法恢复，请先核对在途操作。
